summary: Verdict: ready once ledger/inbox/fable-final-fixes.json is merged (apply evidence_remove first; clear exclusion_reason by hand on the 7 reinstated plants). What was checked: all 40 High and Medium plants were re-derived component by component from their evidence rows against CLAUDE.md and the run-log rules. Open status and dates of every counted posting were re-read today on the primary boards for 22 of the 40: Arcosa UKG (306 postings, 8 plants), Valmont Workday (76, 9 plants), Sabre's own UKG Ready board (221 requisitions, 5 plants). Nello's careers page, the Maico KansasWorks posting and the Nucor Crawfordsville posting were re-read too; the Lever, Dayforce and Paylocity postings behind DIS-TRAN Pineville, the V&S plants and Universal were not. No counted posting had closed, no trigger scored 15 is older than 2024-11-13, and no invented fact, wrong plant or closed plant was found. What was wrong: 8 major and 5 minor findings, no blockers. Six change a score or add a plant: FWT Fort Worth 21 -> 61, Ameron Tulsa (Yukon) 41 -> 61, Nucor Decatur 40 -> 60, Nello South Bend 67 -> 75 (High), Musco 23 -> 28, and a new Sabre plant at Marshall TX (61). Two more keep the total but move it onto stated evidence (Meyer Clinton demand; MICA Haltom City labor). Thirteen plants get street addresses, six map pins move by 8 to 16 km, and seven exclusions that contradict the written inclusion rule become base records. Consistency: the same address-match rule now covers FWT Fort Worth and Sabre Hicksville; V&S Canton and Burton at 12 match QMF, the only other plant whose posting lists TIG; material 20/12 rests on a stated dimension or Path's own statement at all nine plants that have it; every Valmont plant is customer_other_plant, Millerbernd Winsted known_customer, Nello and LaX customer_other_plant. After the merge: 118 plants; 81 profiled, 7 base, 30 excluded; High 9, Medium 35, Low 37. Headline figures the merge makes stale: those counts; profiled_fact_checked (80 of 81); 'every included plant is profiled' (7 base); material unknown (69 of 81); and the miss rate. On the run log's second measure the count rises from 22 of 80 to 30 of 88 = 34.1% (Sabre Marshall plus the 7 reinstated exclusions); the auditor-measured 5/64 needs a re-run of compare_audit.py. Both were already over the 20% advisor threshold logged for the done checkpoint. 'Ready' here means the ledger content; the coordinator still owes the advisor consultation, a fact-check of Sabre Marshall and a rebuilt summary and Method page. Sabre Marshall and the three re-scored Low plants have not been seen by an independent fact-checker; every quote this review wrote was checked on its page today.

findings.finding: FWT Fort Worth (21, Low) and Sabre Hicksville (61, Medium) were scored under opposite rules on the same kind of evidence. Fort Worth's process and labor were zeroed because the tie between Sabre's 'Kenn' postings and the FWT plant was 'inferred'; Hicksville kept both. Primary sources now tie both by address: EPA's Facility Registry names SABRE-FWT at 5750 E. Interstate 20, Fort Worth and at 761 W. High St., Hicksville, and Sabre's own job board gives those streets for its Fort Worth and Hicksville requisitions. At Fort Worth the tie is address plus site code: the board puts every Fort Worth requisition under 5750 I-20, including one coded '36th' (not used), and the counted ones are coded 'Kenn'; EPA lists 'FWT INC EXPANSION' in Kennedale about 300 m from the 5750 record. Fort Worth becomes 61 Medium; Hicksville stays 61 with the FWT history now stated. This reverses a coordinator decision (option b, 53 -> 21), so it is the coordinator's to confirm: if a source naming the Kenn site at this street in so many words is required, Fort Worth returns to 21 and Hicksville is unaffected (one address, no second site code). Fort Worth also gains a street address, FRS coordinates (it was plotted at the city centre, about 13 km away), a name, an opening line and four open welder requisitions.

findings.finding: A Sabre pole plant is missing from the ledger: 2938 Brown Rd, Marshall, TX 75672 (Sabre site code 'MarU', which the coverage fix had listed as unresolved). findings.finding: MICA Haltom City's labor 20 rested on a company-wide signing bonus (careers page of a four-site company) tagged stated at the plant, while MICA Kaufman's labor is 0 because the same bonus 'is not tied to Kaufman'. Total unchanged at 68; confidence 4 -> 3 because MICA's own listings are on Indeed (blocked) and open status is aggregator-only. The bonus row stays stated with company-wide wording (the opening line cites it) but no longer earns points. If the coordinator does not accept aggregator-only listings, labor is 0 and the plant is 48, the treatment Kaufman's aggregator stub gets.

findings.finding: Seven exclusions contradict the inclusion rule the coordinator wrote on 2026-11-13 (a current DOT or certification listing for an in-scope product means included as base, low confidence). Each is on a current state DOT approved list for sign, signal or lighting structures (WisDOT, Maryland SHA, MassDOT); two also name the product on their own site (Ackerman & Baynes 'highway sign structures'; Mid-Park's 'sign structures product line'). They are excluded for 'general fabricator' or 'welding not shown', the test the rule replaced, while Larwel, QMF, Metal Pros and PennFab are included on equivalent listings. The inbox sets all seven to base with a status row; they are not profiled or scored. exclusion_reason must be cleared by hand. Sampled and accepted as excluded: the concrete, composite, galvanizing, mill, duplicate, closed, lattice-tower and 2013-list-only rows, McCook, Ferndale, Salem, TAPP, Pacific Steel, Aura (category-level listing), Hadco and Mid-Park Leitchfield. This is a rule-consistency call: the alternative is to keep them excluded and narrow the written rule.

findings.finding: Process and posting rows that rest on copies. Claremore's GMAW and its 120 in / 80,000 lb part size come from a third-party copy of a posting about two years old; today's Claremore postings name sub-arc only, so the High score (80) depends on the coordinator's 'how a plant welds is a standing fact' ruling. Valmont Tulsa's GMAW is from a posting removed in May 2025; a live 'Sub Arc Base Welder' posting at 801 N Xanthus says 'Apply a backing weld using the GMAW process' but carries the Workday label 'Claremore OK - Utility', so it was not used. Sumterville and Arcosa Telecom process rows are aggregator copies. The five Sabre plants' posting dates come from Tallo copies; Sabre's own board confirms the roles are open and gives the addresses but shows no dates. None changes a score today.

not_verified: Sources behind the material, part-mix and scale rows of the 40 plants were read in the ledger but not re-fetched, except where a finding touches them. Trigger pages for Jasper, Crowley, Klute, V&S Muskogee, Crawfordsville and West Hazleton were not re-fetched (each was confirmed in a fact-check round); their dates were checked against the 2024-11-13 cutoff from the quoted text.
Sabre Marshall: found only on Sabre's own job board; no news, EPA FRS or AISC record. Its products sentence is role text Sabre uses at several pole plants. Needs one independent fact-check.
MICA Haltom City: open status of the three roles is from an aggregator; Indeed (MICA's own listing) is behind a Cloudflare wall.
Nello: the posting pages show 'Jan 30' and 'Feb 2' with no year.
The seven reinstated plants: their DOT listing pages were not re-fetched; the ledger rows are dated 2026-11-12.

p-grid-structures-amite-city-la:weld_processes (process 20, 60 Medium): the FCAW quote is an earlier agent's; the careers list page no longer shows the posting body, so it could not be re-found today. Only the value wording was changed.
FWT Fort Worth: the Kenn-to-plant tie is address plus site code, not a sentence naming the Kenn site at 5750 E I-20.

Leads not followed: a possible further Sabre site in Fort Worth (EPA FRS 'SABRE COMMUNICATIONS CORP, 2400 NE 36TH ST'; Sabre's board has a 'Longseamer B - 36th (Nights)' requisition under the 5750 I-20 address) and Sabre's second Sioux City address (2101 Murray St, EPA FRS 'SABRE TOWERS & POLES'). Neither has a row.

tools/merge_inbox.py --dry-run and tools/apply_removals.py could not be run in this session (blocked as ledger-modifying). The inbox file was checked with a read-only copy of their rules: 0 rejected rows, 0 removal keys missing, 0 duplicate keys, 0 coverage gaps on the plants it touches, score arithmetic re-summed.
Confidence was recomputed by hand only for the plants whose basis changed; the coordinator's normaliser should recompute it after the merge.
